description: We are a father-son team from Taiwan: David (product/design) and Zeyi, age 6, the commander of Moon Base Pals. We are building a cozy 3D-clay browser game teaching kids to run a lunar outpost. Already have character art, story, and prototype. Looking for teammates who love kids games, simple JS/HTML5, 3D/2D art, or video editing. No experience needed — just enthusiasm for space and kids. The whole family is welcome!
